title: /data/v1/sites.json: every site flowcast can forecast (site selector and overview map)

slug.description: Friendly route alias (/site/callicoon); null if none

name.description: Cleaned-up gauge name, e.g. 'Delaware River at Callicoon, NY'

state.description: The town's state (from the station name), not the gauge record's: Callicoon and Lordville are NY although USGS files both gauges under PA

forecast_ready.description: True once the site has a published live forecast (live.json and forecasts exist). Every listed site can be woken with POST /api/visit; false until its first run

forecast_issued_at.description: Issue time of the newest live forecast, or null

status.description: Lazy-forecast status of a ready site; null when not ready

has_temp.description: Water temperature is forecast (the temperature model covers the basin and the gauge reports 00010); false = flow-only

in_training_region.description: Inside the region the models were trained on (HUC2 01 New England, 02 Mid-Atlantic, 05 Ohio). Every model basin is

forecastable.description: The site-eligibility rule holds today (refreshed daily). False e.g. when the gauge stopped reporting discharge; POST /api/visit then answers 409 not_forecastable

not_forecastable_reason.description: Reason code when forecastable is false (gauges.schema.json reason codes, e.g. no_recent_discharge)
